iCal Calendar Deduplicator

Scan .ics calendar exports for duplicate VEVENT entries and export clean calendars. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Parses iCalendar (.ics) export files, detects duplicate VEVENT calendar blocks sharing identical summary, timestamp, and recurrence properties, and exports a streamlined calendar file. Eliminates annoying duplicated calendar alerts across desktop and mobile devices.

How to use

  1. Export your calendar from Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, or Apple Calendar as an .ics file.
  2. Drop the .ics file into the calendar deduplicator tool interface.
  3. The tool parses calendar entries, identifies duplicate event blocks, and removes duplicates.
  4. Download the cleaned .ics file and re-import it into your calendar application.

Limits & Considerations

Deduplicates based on normalized VEVENT string properties. Does not automatically resolve conflicting event time modifications or update remote CalDAV servers.

Privacy & Security

Your personal and professional appointment schedules are kept strictly private on your computer. Zero calendar data is transmitted across the internet.
